summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases under the second tranche of its 2026 buy-back programme announced on 6 May 2026. From 22–26 June 2026, it bought 476,100 own shares at an average price of NOK 312.89 per share. Accumulated under this tranche, 2,314,468 shares were repurchased at an average of NOK 339.91. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 2.64% of its share capital as treasury shares. The buy-back is conducted under EU Market Abuse Regulation. Watch for completion by 20 July 2026 and any updates to the programme pace.
